An update about airflow checks
It is for people travelling soon
Travelers should know that our companion animal procedures are under a careful review, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to help with any trip involving a pet.

Please read your travel papers before you arrive, keep carriers secure, and follow crew directions at every step. Safety comes first, and that means pets and travelers may be guided through a slower process when extra checks are needed. <<FACT F028>>

If you are preparing to fly with Aurelia Skyways, bring the items listed for your route and speak with the desk if your plans change. <<FACT F019>> Clear guidance helps us protect animals in transit and support crews with calm, practical service.

For personal help and the latest travel guidance, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
